title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the doubles tennis match between Adam Pavlasek / Patrik Rikl and Felix Auger-Aliassime / Duncan Chan in the Davis Cup, originally scheduled for November 24 at 12:20PM ET.

This market will resolve to 'Adam Pavlasek / Patrik Rikl' if the team of Adam Pavlasek / Patrik Rikl advances against Felix Auger-Aliassime / Duncan Chan.

This market will resolve to 'Felix Auger-Aliassime / Duncan Chan' if the team of Felix Auger-Aliassime / Duncan Chan advances against Adam Pavlasek / Patrik Rikl.

If the match is canceled (not played at all), ends in a tie, or a winner has not been determined by December 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve to 50-50.

If the match begins but is not completed, and one team advances due to the opponent's retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve to the team who advances.

If the match ends in a walkover (a team withdraws before the start and the other advances automatically), this market will resolve to 50-50.

The primary resolution source will be official information from the International Tennis Federation. A consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
